authorCommits.message:
Key association resource names by field id (#4902)

Two has_many panels rendering the same resource on one show page shared
the listing ids ("<model_key>_body_content", "<model_key>_list") and the
resource names (data-resource-name, data-selected-resources-name). A
search in one panel replaced the other panel's listing, and selecting rows
in one panel fed them into the other panel's actions.

Association panels now use the field id as their resource name, so
for_attribute fields on the same association stay apart too. Action links
carry the field id as via_related_name so the action modal reads the
selection of the panel it was opened from. Top-level index names are
unchanged.
